Ancient Doll and Old Newspaper on Custom_AuroraVineyard; the Rare Seed on Woods until event 7134028): LimitedNumberOfSpawns counters live in FTM's per-save file and the items are vanilla's with vanilla routes, so nothing is written. | Golden Pumpkin (O)373: SVE's Spirit's Eve chest gives one in year 1 (SpiritsEveChestEditor.cs 25-27), the same as vanilla's own table route, so nothing is written. | Razor Trout and Kittyfish: their Data/Locations rows need events 1056732 and 69069247, which no file of SVE 1.15.11 defines, and Razor Trout's Data/Fish entry needs the Joja event 5553210; TLY passes a condition it cannot read, so both keep their data weeks (reported). | YearRulings NeverSell: the deeds, the two schedules, the Golden Key, the Magic Lamp, the Money Bag and the Mermaid's Bracelet are quest and event items. | WeekRulings: TLY's own forage rule reads Data/Locations rows, not layer routes, so every Dependable forage route here is unplaced without a ruling; each is ruled at its first dependable landing from day 1 or its map's walked week when that is later (Woods is week 4). The Chance routes (Big Conch, Dried Sand Dollar, Four Leaf Clover, Poison Mushroom, the cave fruit) get no ruling, as luck is not a supply the board may ask for. | Monster Fruit, Monster Mushroom, Slime Berry and Void Root: their seeds drop only in the Highlands (Ginger Island chain), so they are left unknown; TLY's crop rule still dates them from their seasons, as it dates vanilla's Qi Fruit (reported). | Year 2: weeks 17 to 32 continue the calendar (Spring of year 2 = 17 to 20); each map's gate week is a judgement from SVE's quest chains, one sentence each below. | Post-Community-Center content (Junimo Woods, Forbidden Maze and the Henchman, Grampleton Suburbs, Andy's cellar, the Sprite Spring and its cave, the Garden) is week 17: the Community Center is restored at the year-1 win and the Dark Talisman and Sophia's 8 hearts follow. | Ginger Island arrivals (Fable Reef, the island fish rows, Lance's first rewards) are week 17: the boat is repaired in the Winter of a won year. | The Highlands, their caverns and the dwarf shop are week 19: the Caldera (event 6951319), then Marlon's MarlonFay2 order and event 65360184. | The Enchanted Grove is week 20: the Galaxy Sword, the Caldera, the Railroad boulder (event 8050109) and event 7502582, then event 908071. | Galdora (Castle Village Outpost, Desert Railway, Crimson Badlands, Iridium Quarry, Treasure Cave) is week 21: the Grove, then event 908078. | The Legendary Trio monsters (purple mushroom crab, gold slime, diamond sand scorpion) are week 22: event 1337930 needs the Treasure Cave event 1925178, the Highlands dwarf (55134263), the Henchman and Marlon's 4 hearts; so Mega Purple Mushroom, Gold Slime Egg, Magic Lamp and Galdoran Gem are ruled 22, the gem earlier than Gunther's year-2 museum mail. | Custom_SpriteSpring2 and its cave Custom_SpriteSpringCave are flagged YearTwo: the spring is locked behind the Magic Ink event 418172 (post-Community-Center), so the year-1 walk leaves it and the cave out; Custom_GrandpasShed and its greenhouse can open in year 1 (Robin's order) and are not flagged. | Joja-route content (Morris's property and house, the Joja Emporium vendors Brooklyn, Jace, Zoey and Chloe 1 to 4, Axel 1 and 2, the refurbished Aurora Vineyard and AuroraLedger, Super Joja Cola) is mapped and flagged YearTwo, its routes carry route:Joja (no path on a restored save), and it gets no YearTwoRulings: there is no honest week for it. | BearVendor (Custom_ForestWest after event 2120303) and AdventurerLedger (the Adventurer's Guild after event 5407921) are year-1-reachable shops behind events, so they are not in YearTwoShops; LewisLedger and MorrisLedger have no opener in SVE 1.15.11, so they are left out and the Property Deed stays unknown. | Challenging-config and Low Memory config areas (SVE_Challenging*, SVE_LowMemory* flags, off by default) are left out. | One-time FTM spawns on year-2 maps (LimitedNumberOfSpawns: the Galdoran vendor schedule, Monster Splitter and Heavy Shield chests, the Grampleton Suburbs and Treasure Cave treasure chests, Junimo Woods forage areas 1 to 5) get no route; the vendor schedule is ruled 21 as a reward. | The Treasure Cave chest is an SVE_Lock that takes a Prismatic Shard for the Galaxy Slingshot, not the Magic Lamp; the lamp drops only from the Legendary Diamond Sand Scorpion. | Monster drops: one MonsterDrop route per item per map pooling its default-config areas, always Chance; FTM drops every item in a monster's loot list, so the ruling reads chance 1 (+0) on the monster's mine tier, a monster TLY's mine table lacks reading at the Skull Cavern tier (7) except the Wilderness Golem at floors 1 to 39 (1), a Wilderness farm monster from day 1. | Highlands Sapling Spawns buries 1 to 3 a day picked from 12 items, so each sapling and the Tree Coin is a Chance ArtifactSpot route despite the area's minimum of 1. | Vanilla items in these FTM areas keep their vanilla routes and are not written, except the year-2 Beach forage area 2 (clam, cockle, oyster, Years 2+) and the Dark Shrine of Life's Life Elixir (O)773, which are SVE's own year-2 routes. | Shop rulings read shop 1 + a price step (under 1000g +0, under 4000g +1, otherwise +2, as for an animal's price) + 1 for a vendor open only some days; a craft reads hardest ingredient + unlock (the dish rule without the kitchen); a dish reads kitchen 1; a one-time gift reads reward, effort 3; the shrine Tree Coin reads input + shrine 1 + time 0, as an artisan good. | Big Conch, Dried Sand Dollar, Lucky Four Leaf Clover and Poison Mushroom have only luck routes in year 1, so each is ruled at its first dependable year-2 supply (Fable Reef, the Highlands, the Forbidden Maze). | Already dated by a year-1 rule, no year-2 ruling: Monster Fruit, Monster Mushroom, Slime Berry, Void Root, Kittyfish, Razor Trout, Wolf Snapper, Prismatic Pop, Amber, Boomerang and the other placed ids; Mushroom Colony and Smelly Rafflesia (week rulings), the three saplings and Void Root get year-2 routes only. | Gold Carrot Seed gets year-2 routes but no ruling: its year-1 Desert Trader barter lands. | Clownfish is an all-season island fish: its Data/Fish row says summer, but its three Data/Locations rows (IslandSouth, IslandSouthEast, IslandWest) carry LOCATION_Season Here Spring Summer Fall Winter and govern the spawn in 1.6, so it is ruled 17 with the other Ginger Island fish; Super Starfruit needs Apples' 10-heart chain (event 7776009) and is ruled 17 with the Junimo Woods, to move once played. | Void Eel (WitchSwamp), Snatcher Worm and Water Grub (BugLand) are ruled 17 with the Dark Talisman; those vanilla maps are not flagged, as vanilla's own year-2 content is a later pass. | SVE stock that is not in Data/Objects (the dwarf shop's nodes and decor, Brooklyn's and the Orange Junimo's decor, Alesia's and Isaac's boots and Galaxy weapons, Lance's Diamond Wand) is read with an (O) prefix from unqualified shop lines and is not ruled; the shop flags still mark its routes. | Void Seed drops only before event 1090508 (peace with the shadow people) or, after it, with the flag SVE_BetrayalShrineActivated (Highlands Cavern Monster Seeds - betrayed); peace without the betrayal shrine ends the supply, so the route carries that fork as a gate note and the week-19 ruling stands on the pre-event area. | Dewdrop Berry is ruled 20 although its Lands sends a week-20 start to Summer 1 (week 21): the Enchanted Grove area's spawns last 27 days (DaysUntilSpawnsExpire), so a berry from Spring 14 is still there when the Grove opens. | The Henchman backyard shrines (Tree Coin, Life Elixir) also need the Magic Ink event 418172, the Henchman's 8-heart event part 1 and HenchmanHouseFixed; week 17 is the post-Community-Center bucket taken to include the Magic Ink chain, to move once played. | Ferngill Primrose now has a year-2 Spring route at Custom_SVESummit, and it and Flower Cookie are ruled 17.
